key_risks: Personal guarantee is limited to £300,000, covering only 25% of the loan amount, leaving the bank exposed to borrower default beyond that amount.
Security is limited to a single freehold factory, creating concentration risk despite a comfortable LTV of 64.9%.
mitigants: Loan-to-value of 64.9% provides ample headroom below the 75% policy limit.
Debt service coverage ratio of 1.65x exceeds the minimum 1.25x requirement, indicating strong cash‑flow coverage.
Net debt/EBITDA of 1.9x is well under the 3.5x ceiling, showing a solid leverage position.
Twelve years of trading history demonstrates established operating performance.
Financial covenants (minimum DSCR 1.25x, maximum net debt/EBITDA 3.0x) are documented and stricter than policy thresholds.
risk.summary: Harbourside Precision Engineering Ltd requests a £1.2m secured loan with a 7‑year tenor. The transaction is well‑collateralised (LTV 64.9%) and supported by strong cash‑flow metrics (DSCR 1.65x, net debt/EBITDA 1.9x) and a long trading history. While the personal guarantee is limited to £300k and security is concentrated in a single property, the overall risk profile remains low, justifying an approval with the existing covenants and monitoring arrangements.
